title: Ladd Choate
text:
I’m an Industrial Engineering and Operations Analytics student at the University of Arkansas. Before coming to Fayetteville, I completed coursework at the University of Central Arkansas and Arkansas State University–Beebe.
I’m interested in using data, optimization and simulation to help organizations run more efficiently, from inventory and facility decisions to scheduling and process design.
Outside the classroom, I work in sales, helping established businesses across Northwest and Central Arkansas modernize their websites and online presence. It has taught me how to research a market, qualify leads and communicate value clearly.
